queue.title: The monday.com Pipeline Audit You Should Run Every Quarter (And Exactly How to Do It)
queue.brief: Most revenue doesn't vanish in a single bad deal — it leaks slowly from deals nobody is watching, fields nobody filled in, and stages nobody updated. This post walks monday.com users through a practical, repeatable quarterly pipeline audit they can run themselves to find and fix those leaks before they compound.
queue.description: H2 sections cover: (1) Why pipelines go stale — the four ways dirty data quietly kills momentum; (2) The five fields that are almost always incomplete (and why each one matters for forecasting); (3) How to spot stuck deals in monday.com using filters, sorting, and date columns — with a real-world example of a 47-day-old "Proposal Sent" deal that had no next-action date and no owner; (4) Unowned records: how to find deals with no assigned rep and what to do with them; (5) How to build a simple monday.com dashboard that surfaces pipeline health at a glance; (6) A quarterly audit checklist readers can save and reuse. Target keyword: "monday.com pipeline audit." The post closes by noting that readers who want the scan done for them — with a structured breakdown of every stuck deal, missing value, and unowned record — can run agent7d's free CRM Audit Tool report instead.
